subject.title: [Bug]: 6.x state migration leaves channel conversation-store SQLite empty (0 bytes) — orphans references, breaks proactive (Bot Framework) sends (MS Teams)

question: Should maintainers accept the narrow MS Teams migration visibility guard in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862 as the fix for this issue, or require broader packaged-upgrade/recovery coverage first?
rationale: Persisted conversation migration archive behavior is upgrade-sensitive, and the open linked PR is ready for maintainer judgment rather than another automated fix branch.

options.title: Land The Linked Guard
options.body: Accept the plugin-local visibility check as the immediate fix for non-empty legacy sources that produce no visible conversation rows, with already-archived recovery tracked separately if needed.

options.title: Require Upgrade Transcript
options.body: Ask for a redacted packaged upgrade or doctor transcript before merge if exact release-to-patched behavior must be proven first.

options.title: Broaden Recovery Scope
options.body: Hold the linked PR if maintainers want the same change to recover already archived sources or handle partial-import cases before merge.

recommendation.title: Land The Linked Guard
recommendation.body: Accept the plugin-local visibility check as the immediate fix for non-empty legacy sources that produce no visible conversation rows, with already-archived recovery tracked separately if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the central MS Teams SQLite store and doctor migration history for this archive behavior decision.
